title: Daily Workout · November 17
note: Tuesday recovery-focused session following user-confirmed skipped November 16 workout due to insufficient sleep, work and blood donation. Avoid strenuous activity for at least 24 hours after donation; today's plan is gentle and optional only if rested, hydrated, not dizzy and free of sharp back pain. Recurrent sharp localized lower-right lumbar pain with right-foot loading warrants PT/spine evaluation; do not walk through it even if it sometimes eases after warm-up or Aleve. Keep six established stretches in order, but SKIP plow pose unless specifically medically cleared; reference-only photograph does not match suspended-feet variation. No jogging, forced extension, heavy yard work, or assumptions of actual performance. Topo Phantom 4 Wide preferred based on one good trial; monitor symptoms. Resume established 3% steady / alternating 2%-4% incline sessions only after donation recovery and if consistently pain-free.

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.detail: 1 min · gently alternate sides within the minute
items.instructions: Seated on floor, one leg straight, other foot beside buttock; lean back with arm support only if comfortable. Skip if it provokes lumbar or knee pain. Use existing StretchCoach image registry entry.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Soles together, sit upright, do not force knees down. One 60-second hold, not separate left/right holds.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Use comfortable, controlled motion. Do not force rotation or continue if it provokes sharp back pain.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.detail: 1 min timer · only if specifically cleared
items.instructions: Straight legs with feet suspended, not touching floor. Advanced neck/spine-loading inversion; do not perform without clearance for current lumbar symptoms. Existing photograph showing floor contact is reference-only.

items.name: Arm circles
items.instructions: Gentle circles, comfortable range; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Overhead triceps stretch
items.instructions: Gentle overhead stretch without forcing the shoulder or arching the back; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Warm-up walk
items.instructions: Only begin if well rested, hydrated, at least 24 hours after blood donation and no sharp pain when bearing weight on right foot. Stop if dizziness, weakness, or back pain.

items.name: Easy level walk
items.instructions: Recovery day: no 3% steady or 2%-4% incline intervals today; resume established incline plan on a later symptom-free day. Stop immediately for sharp right lower-back pain rather than warming through it. No jogging.

items.name: Cool-down walk
items.instructions: Gradually slow and stop if lightheaded or uncomfortable. Topo Phantom 4 Wide as tolerated; no assumptions about longer-term fit.

items.name: Band pull-aparts
items.instructions: Use separate light rubber PT resistance band held freely in both hands at chest height, not wall-mounted rows. Relax shoulders and keep spine neutral; stop if pain.

items.name: Wall angels
items.instructions: Small comfortable range, no forced lumbar extension; skip if sharp back discomfort.

items.name: Chin tucks
items.instructions: Keep neck neutral, move gently without straining.

items.name: Wall-anchored band chest stretch
items.instructions: Use securely mounted wall bands at shoulder height with light tension; keep spine neutral. No doorway stretch.

items.name: Posture reset / transition
items.instructions: Comfortable standing or seated posture, no back arching; stop for symptoms.
